name: Rumi Embellished Net Gown
description: A floor-length ball gown in blush pink net, covered in tonal sequin and thread embroidery. It has a square neckline, a fitted bodice and a full flared skirt, with sheer cape panels that fall from the shoulders to the hem. Fully lined. Made for weddings, receptions and festive evenings.

name: Shefali Floral Puff-Sleeve Maxi Dress
description: A flowing maxi dress in navy with large cream and peach flowers. It has a sweetheart neckline with a bow at the front, short balloon sleeves that end at the elbow and a full skirt that reaches the ankle. A good choice for lunches, garden parties and daytime events.

name: Laila Beaded Tulle Gown
description: A floor-length gown in crimson tulle with a high neck, full sleeves and a very full layered skirt. Silver beadwork runs in lines from the shoulders down over the bodice. Fully lined and modest, with full coverage. Made for weddings, engagements and formal evenings.

name: Noor Belted Abaya
description: A floor-length abaya in soft blush beige with wide full sleeves and a matching tie belt at the waist. Tonal leaf embroidery runs down the front and the sleeves, and pleated chiffon panels open the skirt into a flare from the knee. Loose, modest and light enough for all-day wear.

name: Meher Beaded Silk Kaftan
description: A loose kaftan dress in a blue, turquoise and violet print, with a shaped neckline and cuffs covered in hand-sewn beads and sequins. It has full sleeves, falls below the knee and comes with a matching neck scarf. Suited to Eid, dinners and festive gatherings.

name: Bela Block-Print Kurti
description: A short kurti top in ivory cotton with a grey-blue and mustard flower print. It has a V-neck with a button placket, three-quarter sleeves and a relaxed fit that falls to the hip. Easy to wear with jeans or the store's trousers. The jeans in the photo are not included.

name: Tara Paisley Satin Tunic
description: A long tunic in lavender-grey satin with a paisley and fern print and a deep red flower border at the hem. It has a V-neck with an embroidered placket and wide three-quarter sleeves, and falls to mid-thigh. Pairs well with plain trousers.

name: Mira Crochet Fringe Poncho
description: An open-knit crochet poncho in cream with a V-neck and a pointed hem finished with long fringe. It slips over the head and is one size that fits most. An easy layer over a plain top or a dress. Hand wash only.

name: Lina Polka Dot Midi Skirt
description: A high-waisted A-line midi skirt in deep red with small white polka dots. It falls to mid-calf and moves easily when walking. Pairs with a plain top or the Bela Block-Print Kurti. The white top in the photo is not included.

name: Sana Floral Border Skirt
description: A tiered midi skirt in white cotton with a navy and blue flower print and a wide patterned border at the hem. The elastic waist makes it comfortable, and it falls to mid-calf. Light and cool for daytime wear.

name: Ira Printed Palazzo Trousers
description: High-waisted palazzo trousers in black with a grey leaf print. They have an elastic waist with a tie at the front and very wide legs that reach the ankle. Soft, loose and comfortable for everyday wear.

name: Piya Drawstring Trousers
description: Straight-leg trousers in dusty pink crepe with an elastic waist and a drawstring. They end at the ankle and hang loosely without clinging. Pairs with the Bela Block-Print Kurti or a plain shirt.

name: Roshni Pleated Ankle Trousers
description: High-waisted tapered trousers in bright yellow cotton twill, with front pleats, side pockets and belt loops. They end just above the ankle. Smart enough for the office with a plain shirt. The belt in the photo is not included.

name: Neela Chambray Wide-Leg Trousers
description: Wide-leg trousers in light blue chambray, a soft cotton that looks like denim but is much lighter. They have an elastic paper-bag waist with a tie belt and a frayed hem at the ankle. Cool and easy for warm days.

name: Ayra Floral Co-ord Set
description: A two-piece set in mauve cotton with a cream flower print. The shirt-style top has a V-neck with a trimmed placket and three-quarter sleeves, and the matching wide-leg trousers end above the ankle. Wear them together or separately. The bag in the photo is not included.

name: Kaya Twist Top and Trouser Set
fabric: Crepe trousers with a cotton jersey top
description: A two-piece set: high-waisted wide-leg trousers in rust crepe and a white jersey top with a twist at the front and short sleeves edged with a patterned trim. Wear them together or separately. The belt, shoes and sunglasses in the photo are not included.
